lines: Yeh achchhi parda-daari hai

lines: Yeh achchhi raaz-daari hai

lines: Jo aaye tumhaari bazm mein deewana ho jaaye
couplets.en: Whoever enters your gathering loses their senses.

lines: Tu ne deewana banaya to main deewana bana
couplets.en: You made me mad with love, and so I was.

lines: Zauq-e-barbaadi-e-dil ko bhi na kar tu barbaad

lines: Tu sanam bhi hai, tu khuda bhi hai, tera kya kehna

lines: Yeh tamanna hai ke aazaad-e-tamanna hi rahoon

lines: Dil-e-maayoos ko maanoos-e-tamanna na bana
